Wolf"Ah, Cannon! Keeping well?"
Wolf"You haven't thrown away hope, I trust?"
Cannon"Professor Wolf?!"
Wolf"Good, good. At least you're alive. I was terribly worried you'd simply gone and hanged yourself."

Wolf"A comrade helped me."
Cannon"A comrade?"
Wolf"This gentleman."

Cannon"...Professor. Isn't he from Yamato?"
Wolf"Yes, from Yamato, and a friend of mine. At present, is that really the thing we need to discuss?"
Wolf"Come now, Lieutenant Colonel. We resume."
Cannon"Resume what?"
Wolf"Arre, wake up. Our contest, of course!"
Cannon"...Now? It's all over already."
Cannon"At present I am a traitor waiting for execution. Escape from here, and what do I become? At best, a fugitive waiting for arrest."
Wolf"Don't talk so pathetically. Didn't Major General Willow entrust his dream to you?"
Cannon"..."
Wolf"As far as the public is concerned, you are not a traitor yet."
Cannon"...What did you say?"
Wolf"Ruby Sarchant doesn't know the full extent of the independence faction hiding inside GHQ. He's afraid that announcing what happened may send them out of control."
Wolf"Correct, Bartolomeo?"
Jouansai"Yes."
Cannon"..."
Wolf"You understand, Lieutenant Colonel, no?"
Wolf"If only Count Sarchant were out of the way, even now we could salvage this!"
Cannon"..."

キャノン「……教授。 　彼は大和人では？」
ウォルフ「ああそうだ。大和人で、僕の友人だよ。 　今はそんなことどうだっていいだろう？」
ウォルフ「さ、中佐。再開するんだ」
キャノン「何をです」
ウォルフ「寝惚けてるんじゃない。 　僕らの勝負を、だ。もちろん」
キャノン「……今更。 　もう全ては終わっていますよ」
キャノン「今の私は処刑を待つ反逆者です。 　ここから脱出したところで、せいぜい逮捕 を待つ逃亡者にしかなれません」
ウォルフ「情けないことを言うな。 　君はウィロー少将から夢を託されたんじゃ ないのか」
キャノン「……」
ウォルフ「君は表向き、まだ反逆者ではない」
キャノン「……何ですと？」
ウォルフ「ルービィ・サシュアントはＧＨＱ内に潜む 独立派の全貌を把握していないんだ。 　だから事件の公表によって彼らが暴走する 可能性を恐れている」
ウォルフ「そうだね、バルトロメオ？」
常闇斎「はい」
キャノン「…………」
ウォルフ「わかるだろう、中佐」
ウォルフ「サシュアント伯爵さえいなくなれば、ここ からでもまだ何とかなる！」
キャノン「……」

Cannon"...And I have no wish to sit through the full performance of your face either."
Wolf"Well done, Lieutenant Colonel! But the real business starts now."
Wolf"Take GHQ back, move the troops, seize the Forged Bomb, and drop it on Fudaraku Castle!"
Cannon"We cannot jump straight to that. First we must withdraw our ground troops from around the castle..."
Jouansai"That should not take long. The occupation army already appears to be preparing to withdraw."
Cannon"What?"
Cannon"————No, I see. That fellow Sarchant intended to start the whole business over."
Wolf"Which saves us some trouble. But Lieutenant Colonel, this is no time to relax."
Wolf"If Rokuhara takes advantage of the withdrawal and comes out of the castle, the bomb won't wipe them out together. Chalo, let's hurry!"
Cannon"...Yes, Professor—"

en.html:
Jouansai"Whom can I blame? By my own choice, I threw it all away..."
Jouansai"Only faith I kept. To protect it... to raise it higher, everything else I sacrificed."
Jouansai"Just... to feel the presence of God a little nearer..."
Sayo"...Is God the only one who can save your soul?"
Jouansai"Yes."
Sayo"Sayo couldn't save it, after all..."
Jouansai"..."
Jouansai"Ah... but. Yes. One thing I still haven't thrown away."
Jouansai"You. Not yet."
Jouansai"You... I never did forget."
Sayo"...Koshirou..."
Jouansai"The premonition was right."
Jouansai"My fate is here."
Jouansai"You too... I must give you up. ...To welcome God..."
Sayo"..."
